final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS f, COUNT(DISTINCT s.arcref) AS c FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(c) AS t FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.f AS f, s1.c AS c, CAST(s1.c AS REAL) / NULLIF(s2.t, 0) AS r FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.t IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(c) AS a FROM s3) SELECT s3.f, s3.c, s3.r, s3.c - s4.a AS diff FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.a IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.c > s4.a
